channel_description: Use Antigravity subscription models, web search, and account quota monitoring.
system_prompt_prefix_description: Enabled by default to avoid Antigravity keyword checks triggering 429. Keeps only the native prefix in the system section and moves client system/developer instructions to a leading turn; disable to send as-is.
authorization_description: Sign in through Google, then paste the code displayed by the Antigravity callback page. Third-party OAuth access may violate Google's terms and lead to account suspension.
